title: Text 3
subtitle: 《弗兰肯斯坦》与人工智能的伦理

sentences.en: This year marks exactly two centuries since the publication of Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus, by Mary Shelley.
sentences.zh: 今年恰好是玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦——或现代普罗米修斯》出版两百周年。

sentences.en: Even before the invention of the electric light bulb, the author produced a remarkable work of speculative fiction that would foreshadow many ethical questions to be raised by technologies yet to come.
sentences.zh: 早在电灯泡发明之前，作者就创作了一部杰出的推想小说，预示了未来技术将提出的许多伦理问题。

sentences.en: Today the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) raises fundamental questions: “What is intelligence, identity, or consciousness?
sentences.zh: 如今，人工智能（AI）的飞速发展提出了一些根本性的问题："什么是智能、身份或意识？

sentences.en: What makes humans humans?”
sentences.zh: 是什么让人成为人？"

sentences.en: What is being called artificial general intelligence, machines that would imitate the way humans think, continues to evade scientists.
sentences.zh: 所谓的人工通用智能——模仿人类思维方式的机器——至今仍是科学家们无法企及的目标。

sentences.en: Yet humans remain fascinated by the idea of robots that would look, move, and respond like humans, similar to those recently depicted on popular sci-fi TV series such as “Westworld” and “Humans.”
sentences.zh: 然而，人类依然对在相貌、动作和反应上都与人类相似的机器人的想法着迷，类似最近在《西部世界》《人形》等热门科幻电视剧中描绘的那种机器人。

sentences.en: Just how people think is still far too complex to be understood, let alone reproduced, says David Eagleman, a Stanford University neuroscientist.
sentences.zh: 斯坦福大学的神经科学家戴维·伊格尔曼说，人类究竟是如何思考的，这个问题仍然过于复杂，难以理解，更不用说复制了。

sentences.en: “We are just in a situation where there are no good theories explaining what consciousness actually is and how you could ever build a machine to get there.”
sentences.zh: "我们只是身处这样一种境况：没有好的理论能够解释意识到底是什么，以及你怎样才能造出一台机器达到那种状态。"

sentences.en: But that doesn’t mean crucial ethical issues involving AI aren’t at hand.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着涉及AI的关键伦理问题不会出现。

sentences.en: The coming use of autonomous vehicles, for example, poses thorny ethical questions.
sentences.zh: 例如，即将投入使用的自动驾驶汽车就带来了棘手的伦理问题。

sentences.en: Human drivers sometimes must make split-second decisions.
sentences.zh: 人类驾驶员有时必须在瞬间做出决定。

sentences.en: Their reactions may be a complex combination of instant reflexes, input from past driving experiences, and what their eyes and ears tell them in that moment.
sentences.zh: 他们的反应可能是本能反应、过往驾驶经验以及那一刻眼睛和耳朵所接收的信息等多种因素复杂结合的结果。

sentences.en: AI “vision” today is not nearly as sophisticated as that of humans.
sentences.zh: 如今，AI的"视觉"远不如人类的视觉精密。

sentences.en: And to anticipate every imaginable driving situation is a difficult programming problem.
sentences.zh: 而要预见到所有可以想象到的驾驶状况，是一个难以解决的编程问题。

sentences.en: Whenever decisions are based on masses of data, “you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions,” notes Tan Kiat How, chief executive of a Singapore-based agency that is helping the government develop a voluntary code for the ethical use of AI.
sentences.zh: Tan Kiat How表示，只要决策基于海量数据，"你就会很快陷入大量伦理问题之中"。Tan Kiat How是一家新加坡机构的首席执行官，该机构正在协助政府制定AI伦理使用的自愿准则。

sentences.en: Along with Singapore, other governments and mega-corporations are beginning to establish their own guidelines.
sentences.zh: 与新加坡一样，其他国家和大型企业也正开始制定自己的准则。

sentences.en: Britain is setting up a data ethics center.
sentences.zh: 英国正在建立数据伦理中心。

sentences.en: India released its AI ethics strategy this spring.
sentences.zh: 印度今年春天发布了其AI伦理战略。

sentences.en: On June 7 Google pledged not to “design or deploy AI” that would cause “overall harm,” or to develop AI-directed weapons or use AI for surveillance that would violate international norms.
sentences.zh: 6月7日，谷歌承诺不会"设计或部署"会造成"整体危害"的AI，也不会研发AI武器或利用AI从事违反国际准则的监视活动。

sentences.en: It also pledged not to deploy AI whose use would violate international laws or human rights.
sentences.zh: 它还承诺不会部署其用途会违反国际法或人权的AI。

sentences.en: While the statement is vague, it represents one starting point.
sentences.zh: 尽管这一声明措辞含糊，但它代表了一个起点。

sentences.en: So does the idea that decisions made by AI systems should be explainable, transparent, and fair.
sentences.zh: AI系统作出的决策应该可以解释、透明且公平，这一想法同样也是一个起点。

sentences.en: To put it another way: How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity’s highest values?
sentences.zh: 换句话说：我们怎样才能确保智能机器的思考反映出人类最高的价值观？

sentences.en: Only then will they be useful servants and not Frankenstein’s out-of-control monster.
sentences.zh: 只有到那时，它们才会成为有用的仆人，而不是弗兰肯斯坦那个失控的怪物。

questions.stem: Mary Shelley’s novel Frankenstein is mentioned because it ______

options.A: fascinates AI scientists all over the world.
options.B: has remained popular for as long as 200 years.
options.C: involves some concerns raised by AI today.

questions.analysis: 通过题干Mary Shelly’s novel Frankenstein及题文同序原则可定位至文章第一段，在该段尾句,fiction that would foreshadow many ethical questions to be raised by technologies yet to come. 此句中 ethical questions 可同义替换题干中的concern。故C为正选。

questions.stem: In David Eagleman’s opinion, our current knowledge of consciousness ______

options.B: can be misleading to robot making.
options.D: is too limited for us to reproduce it.

questions.analysis: 观点细节题。可通过关键词consciousness 回文定位至原文第2段尾句部分：we are just in a situation where there are no good theories explaining what consciousness actually is and how you could ever build a machine to get there. 可知我们将意识注入机器的能力是有限的，因为没有好的理论可以解释。

questions.stem: The solution to the ethical issues brought by autonomous vehicles ______
questions.analysis: 根据题干关键词可定位至文章第3段,AI “vision”today is not nearly as sophisticated as that of humans.And to anticipate every imaginable driving situation is a difficult programming problem.该句说到：当下，人工智能的思维还不能达到人类的精密程度，去让机器去预设每一种驾驶情形是一个困难的编程问题。由此说明，去解决人工智能所带来的道德问题，是在人类的能力范围之外的。

questions.stem: The author’s attitude toward Google’s pledges is one of ______
questions.analysis: 态度题 ，根据题干中的 the author’s attitude ,Google’s pledges.回文定位到第八段，，开头while转折，while the statement is vague, 与vague相反的即是观点，所以表示正向情感的词即是正解。affirmation表示确定。

questions.stem: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?

options.A: AI’s Future: In the Hands of Tech Giants.
options.B: Frankenstein, the Novel Predicting the Age of AI.
options.C: The Conscience of AI: Complex But Inevitable.
options.D: AI Shall Be Killers Once Out of Control.
